pages.text: Moon's Whatsits also has a few proper prepared foods rather than just ingredients and snacks.$(br2)These recipes use familiar ingredients and turn them into something a bit more substantial.

pages.title: Meals
pages.text: The meals currently added are Avocado Toast, Scrambled Eggs, Sunny Side Eggs and Cooked Cow Ribs.

Recipes:$(br)Avocado Toast: Avocado + Bread$(br)Scrambled Eggs: 2 Egg Yolks$(br)Sunny Side Eggs: Egg Yolk cooked on a Campfire$(br)Cooked Cow Ribs: Raw Cow Ribs cooked in a Furnace, Smoker or Campfire.

Egg Yolk is obtained by throwing a normal Egg. Raw Cow Ribs can be obtained from cows when killed with a suitable knife or cleaver.$(br2)Both are ingredients for the cooked foods above rather than having ordinary crafting recipes.
